verses.text: Ixlajwi chi' ix k'e wa'an heb' smasanil. Ix yik'anb'at Jesús heb' t'a yichanh winhaj Pilato.

Hata' ix syamoch heb' yak'anoch juntzanh es t'a yib'anh. Ix laj yalan heb': --Ix kila' to a winh wan yak'an somchajel heb' ketchonhab'. Syalanpax winh to max yal kak'an k'e'en tumin sk'anjiel t'ayonh yuj winh yajal t'a Roma. Ha wal winh tz'alanpaxi to Cristo winh, syalelk'ochi to rey winh, xchi heb' t'a winhaj Pilato chi'.
Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ej winhaj Pilato chi' t'ay: --Tzin k'anb'ej t'ayach, ¿tom sreyal ach heb' israel? xchi winh t'ay. --Ha in toni, ichaton tzutej halan chi', xchi Jesús t'a winh.
Yuj chi', ix yal winhaj Pilato chi' t'a heb' winh sat sacerdote yet' t'a heb' anima chi': --Malaj jab'ok smul jun winh tik tz'ilchaj wu'uj, xchi winh.

Palta haxo heb', yelk'olal yalan heb': --Ha winh tik, masanil heb' anima aj Judea tik wan somchajel yuj juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al syak' winh. Hato t'a Galilea ix schael yich winh yalani, masanto ix jawi winh t'a Judea tik, xchi heb' t'a winhaj Pilato chi'.
Ayik ix yab'an juntzanh chi' winhaj Pilato chi', ix sk'anb'an winh yab' t'a heb', tato a Jesús aj Galilea.
Haxo yik ix yab'an winh to aj Galilea, yuj chi' ix yak'anb'at t'a winhaj Herodes yajal t'a Galilea chi' yujto ayek' winh t'a Jerusalén t'a juntzanh k'ual chi'.
Ayik ix yilan winhaj Herodes chi' sk'och Jesús, te wach' ix yab' winh, yujto ayxo stiempoal yab'an spekal winh. Yuj chi' sganaxo winh slolon yet'ok. Snib'ej wal winh syil sb'o'an junok milagro.
Tzijtum tas ix sk'anb'ej winh t'ay, haxo Jesús manh jab'ok ix tak'wi t'a winh.
Haxo heb' winh sat sacerdote yet' heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés ayek' ta', yelk'olal ix yak'och heb' winh t'a yib'anh.

Yuj chi' a winhaj Herodes chi' yet' heb' soldado, ix sb'aj Jesús chi' heb'. Ix sb'uchan pax heb'. Ix stz'akan yak'och juntzanh pichul heb' te wach' t'ay, icha spichul heb' winh rey. Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anxi meltzaj Jesús winh t'a winhaj Pilato.
Ha t'a jun k'ual chi' ix yamigoejk'e sb'a winhaj Pilato chi' yet' winhaj Herodes, yujto ha t'a yalanhtaxo yajk'o'ol sb'a heb' winh.
Haxo winhaj Pilato chi' ix molb'an heb' winh sat sacerdote, heb' winh ay yopisio yet' pax heb' anima smasanil.

Ix yalanelta winh t'a skal heb': --Ha winh ix ul eyak' tik t'ayin, yujto tzeyala' to somchajel heb' anima yuj winh, palta ina t'a eyichanh ix in k'anb'ej wab' t'a winh, palta malaj jab'ok smul winh scheklajelta wuj icha ix aj eyalani.
Hanheja' pax winhaj Herodes, malaj tas ix ilchaj yuj winh t'a winh. Yuj chi' ix schekxikot winh t'ayonh. Inai, malaj jab'ok smul winh yik smoj schami.
Yuj chi', tonhej ol in chek mak'jok winh, ol wak'anxiel winh t'a libre, xchi winh t'a heb'.
Haxo yik ix yab'an heb' anima to icha chi', ix laj awajk'e heb': --Ha winh tik, chamokab' winh. Aokab' winhaj Barrabás chi' tz'el t'a libre, xchi heb'.
Ha winhaj Barrabás chi', preso yaj winh, yujto lokan winh yet' heb' winh ix ak'an owal yet' heb' winh yajal t'a yol chonhab' chi'. Mak'umcham anima pax winh.
Haxo winhaj Pilato chi' snib'ej winh syak'el Jesús t'a libre. Yuj chi' icha chi' ix yutej winh yalanxi t'a heb' anima.
Palta ayik ix yab'an heb' to icha chi', ix k'e umnaj heb' yawaji: --Kulusejk'e winh. Kulusejk'e winh, xchi heb'.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Pilato chi' yoxelal t'a heb': --¿Tas wal smul winh t'ayex jun? Malaj wal jab'ok smul winh tz'ilchaj wu'uj yik smoj schami. Yuj chi' tonhej ol in chek mak'jok winh, ol wak'anxiel winh t'a libre, xchi winh t'a heb'.
Haxo heb', ix te k'e umnaj yawaji to yowalil skulusajk'ei. Te cha'anh ix awajk'e heb' yet' heb' winh sat sacerdote. Yuj chi' ix yak' ganar heb'.
Ix yalan winhaj Pilato chi': Ujokab' icha snib'ej heb', xchi winh.
Haxo winh lokan t'a skal owal chi', winh mak'umcham anima chi', winh preso yaji, a winh ix ak'jielta t'a libre icha snib'ej heb'. Haxo Jesús ix ak'jikanoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' icha snib'ej.

Ayik wan yik'anb'at Jesús heb' b'aj ol chamok, ay jun winh aj Cirene skuchan Simón, spetoj winh t'a smunlajel, ix yamchaj winh yuj heb' soldado. Haxo winh ix chekji skuchb'at skulusal Jesús chi'. Ix och tzak'an winh yuj.
Tzijtum heb' anima ix och tzak'an yuj. Yet' pax heb' ix ix, wek'ek'i yel yaw heb' ix yok' yuj.
Haxo Jesús ix meltzajb'at k'elan t'a heb' ix, ix yalani: --Ex ix aj Jerusalén, manh ex ok' wu'uj. Ok'anhek eyu'uj yet' yuj heb' eyune',
yujto ay wal jun k'ual ol jawok, ol eyalani: Ha wal heb' ix malaj yune', heb' ix toxon max unewi yet' heb' ix manh yojtakok yak'an chunok yune', te wach' yik heb' ix, xe chama.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ol laj yal heb' anima icha tik: Tzok wal kot juntzanh witz yet' juntzanh tzalkixtak tik t'a kib'anh yik tzonh sk'ub'ejeli, xcham heb'.

Ha in tik, lajan in icha junok te te' ya'ax, palta ina wal tas syak'och heb' t'a wib'anh. Okxom wal a ex tik. Yelxo wal niwan tas ol ak'jokoch t'a eyib'anh, yujto lajan ex icha junok te te' takinhxo, xchi Jesús t'a heb' ix.
Ay pax chawanh heb' winh ay smul ix ik'jib'at yet' Jesús chi', yik skulusajk'e heb' winh yet'ok.

Ix k'och heb' t'a jun lugar skuchan B'aj Ay Sb'akil Jolom. Hata' ix kulusajk'e Jesús yuj heb' winh soldado. Ix kulusajpaxk'e chawanh heb' winh ay smul chi' yet'ok, jun winh t'a swach', jun winh t'a sk'exanh. Junjun skulusal junjun heb'.

Ayik wan sk'e t'unhunhok Jesús yuj heb', ix yalani: --Mamin, ak' niwank'olal heb', yujto manh yojtakok heb' tas wan sk'ulani, xchi t'a Dios. Haxo heb' winh soldado, ix yak' suerte heb' winh yik spojanek' spichul Jesús chi' heb' winh t'a spatik.

Haxo heb' anima, wan yilan heb' tas wan yuji chi'. Hanheja' pax heb' winh yajal, ix sb'uch Jesús heb' winh. Ix laj yalan heb' winh: --Ab'i chi' kolwajwum winh t'a juntzanhxo. Skolokab' pax sb'a winh tiknaik, tato t'a wal yel Cristo winh, winh sik'b'ilel yuj Dios, xchi heb' winh.
Hanheja' ix b'uchji pax yuj heb' winh soldado. Ix k'och heb' winh t'a stz'ey. Ix yak'an vinagre heb' winh yuk'ej.
Ix yalan heb' winh t'ay: --Tato yel Sreyal ach heb' israel, kolto naik a b'a kila', xchi heb' winh t'ay.
Ay jun letra ix tz'ib'ajoch t'a sjolom te' skulusal, xchi icha tik: Ha winh tik Sreyal heb' israel, xchi.
Ay pax jun winh kulusab'ilk'e yet'ok ix b'uchani, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Tato yel Cristo ach, kol a b'a kila', tzonh a kolan paxi, xchi winh t'ay.
Haxo junxo winh yetb'eyum winh ix kachani, ix yalan winh: --¿Tom max ach xiw t'a Dios? Ina lajan kajoch t'a yol sk'ab' jun ya'elal tik yet'ok.
Ha onh tik, smoj wal skab' sya'il ko cha'an spak ko mul, palta a jun winh tik, malaj tas ix smulej, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh t'a Jesús: --Ach Jesús, tzin a nakoti ayik ol ach ja ak' Yajalil, xchi winh t'ay.
Ix yalan Jesús t'a winh: --Wal yel swal t'ayach, ha t'a jun k'u tik ol ach k'och wet' t'a swach'ilal, xchi t'a winh.
Ayik toxo tz'och chimk'ualil, ix k'ik'b'i k 'inal t'a masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik masanto t'a a las tres yik yemk'ualil.
Ha yok k'u, majxo yak'laj yok. Haxo k'apak cortina ayoch smakulok snanhal yol stemplo Dios, ix nhik'chaj snanhal k'apak.
Haxo Jesús te cha'anh ix awaji, ix yalan icha tik: --Mamin, swab'enejkanoch in pixan t'a yol a k'ab', xchi t'a Dios. Ix lajwinhej yalan jun chi', ix chami.
Haxo jun winh capitán aj Roma, ayik ix yilan juntzanh chi' winh, ix yal wach' lolonel winh t'a Dios, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Wal yel a jun winh tik, te malaj smul winh, xchi winh.
Haxo masanil heb' anima ayek' chi' ta', ix yil heb' tas ix uji chi'. Ix laj paxta heb', ix och wal pitz'an kusk'olal t'a spixan heb'.
Haxo jantaknhej heb' ojtannak Jesús yet' juntzanh heb' ix ix kotnak yet' t'a Galilea, najatto ix laj kotkan t'anhjab' heb' ix.
Ay jun winh skuchan José, aj chonhab' Arimatea t'a yol yik Judea. Wach' winh, tojol spensar winh. Ay pax yopisio winh yet' heb' winh yajal.
Palta maj yak'och sb'a winh yet' heb' winh ix ak'anoch chamel t'a yib'anh Jesús chi'. Wan stanhwan winh swach' och Dios Yajalil.
Ix k'och winh t'a winhaj Pilato, yik sk'ananemta sniwanil Jesús winh.

Ixlajwi yik'an spermiso winh chi', ix b'at yak'an ik'jokemta sniwanil chi' winh. Ix sb'ak'anoch jun sábana winh t'a spatik. Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at yak'an ak'jok och sniwanil winh t'a yol jun k'e'en k'e'en joyb'ilel yo'ol. Ha t'a jun k'e'en chi', manta junok mach smukchaji.
Haton t'a jun k'ual chi' wanxo yak'an lista sb'a heb' yuj sk'ual ik'oj ip toxo ol yamchaj ochok.
Haxo heb' ix ix kotnak yet' Jesús t'a Galilea, ix b'at heb' ix yil k'e'en k'e'en b'aj ix mukchaj chi'. Ix yilan heb' ix chajtil ix yutej heb' yak'anoch sniwanil chi' t'a yol k'e'en.

Ixlajwi chi', ix paxta heb' ix t'a sposado. Ix laj sb'o'an juntzanh yal suk'uk'i sjab' heb' ix yet' juntzanh wach' sukjioch t'a sniwanil Jesús chi'. Haxo yik ix k'och yorail sk'ual ik'oj ip, ix yik'an yip heb' ix icha yalan jun cheknab'il t'a ley.
